How organizations can capture value from digital colleagues

As artificial intelligence systems become more capable, companies need to think beyond individual tools and begin managing AI as a digital colleague that participates in teams, workflows, and business processes.

Design work around human and digital strengths

Organizations can capture value by defining responsibilities, escalation paths, and performance measures for AI-enabled work. Managers also need to help employees learn how to delegate, review outputs, and intervene when judgment or accountability requires a person.
